text:
maria: Heads up — I noticed a weird spike on the per-model cost heatmap this morning. EU-WEST p4d billed tokens for `gpt-redwood-xl` jumped ~3.8x overnight. Can someone pull the per-route breakdown?
ashok: Paging the query now. initial glance shows traffic routed to `chat-long` route spiked and had high avg seq len.
kevin: Putting the daily per-route cost query here: ```SELECT route, model, SUM(token_cost) AS cost, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency) AS p95 FROM billing.events WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND date='2026-11-19' GROUP BY route, model ORDER BY cost DESC;```
jamie: Oof, `chat-long` is routing to xl by default for that customer cohort. We had canary to xl for better quality last week — maybe rollout didn't rollback? @kevin can you confirm if rollout flag was applied? :thinking_face:
kevin: Confirmed the rollout flag is still on for 3 customers in prod. I see a spike in 03:00-06:00 window.
finops-bot: Daily spend snapshot: total infra spend +18% vs baseline. EU-WEST GPUs +27%. Reserved capacity utilization for p4d in eu-west-1 is 62% (target 85%).
sre-oncall: Noted. Cluster telemetry shows a temporary autoscaler bug that over-provisioned by 12 nodes around 03:10 due to a race with spot eviction signals. We've already reverted the autoscaler patch.
maria: So two contributors: a rollout that increased xl traffic and an autoscaler overshoot. Both inflate short-term burn. Need a mitigation plan: revert rollout for non-critical cohorts + claim credits for overshoot?
ashok: Mit plan proposal: 1) rollback rollout to previous model variant for the 3 customers (immediate), 2) re-route long-chat queue to cheaper quantized `gpt-redwood-large` for best-effort customers, 3) file a billing dispute for the autoscaler over-provision window with cloud ops.
jamie: I'll flip the rollout in the console and add an explicit routing policy fallback. Doing it now. :rocket:
kevin: Done — rollout toggled off for 3 customers, routes updated to prefer `gpt-redwood-large` for non-enterprise tag.
finops-bot: Noting expected savings estimate: rollback + re-route = ~11% reduction in eu-west GPU spend, dispute window claim could recover ~4%.
maria: Good. Action items: @sre-oncall investigate autoscaler race and add a safety cap to prevent >90% of reserved pool from being consumed by spot-induced scale-ups. @kevin monitor the per-route cost panel for next 6 hours and post snapshots. Ashok, can you add a temporary alert on per-model burn rate >2x baseline?
ashok: Alert created: per_model_burn_rate_alert (threshold 2.0x baseline, 5m eval).
sre-oncall: Will triage autoscaler tomorrow AM and create a postmortem if root cause persists. For now we've added the cap and a cooldown.
maria: Thanks team. Let's reconvene in 2 hours if the dashboard hasn't normalized. Please paste any billing dispute ticket IDs here once created. :thumbsup:
